candidate.fp16: projection profile: N>=8192 M32/N128/W8; N>=1024 M32/N64/W4; smaller M16/N32/W4. Always K64/stages2/FP32 accumulate/FP16 output.
candidate.marlin: Explicit fixed block M16 or M32 with full-K and no atomic; never selected by runtime batch M.

caveats: RTX4060 Laptop operator graphs, not A100 model throughput, acceptance or KV/Conv/SSM validation.
Synthetic checkpoint-shaped AWQ weights and uniform/hot32 synthetic routing; trained checkpoint weights not loaded.
Token-local bundles are serial router -> routed experts -> shared expert -> projections, without Attention/GDN recurrence or shared-expert stream overlap.
Each lane is one CUDA Graph. Mixed includes operator input packing/padding but excludes input refresh, CPU metadata, capture/JIT and quantization.
The full M16 run includes extra hot32-labelled primitive rows; these FP16-only operators do not consume routing bias. Interpret them as extra random-input repeats, not routing comparisons.
Timing p95 describes trial means, not token output intervals. Compare interleaved lanes within a row.
Exploratory sweeps predate the final projection profile and frozen-reference loader. Final M16 measured source snapshots and final M32/boundary source versions are retained.
